test(infra): make the local suite hermetic, deterministic, cross-platform (#62)

Five local-only test failures (all green on CI) came from the suite not being
robust to a developer machine. No product/runtime code is touched; CI behaviour
is unchanged by construction.

- Hermetic DB, CI-guarded (vitest.setup.ts): on a LOCAL run (not CI, unless
  FORCE_REAL_PRISMA=true) force DATABASE_URL="stub" so @sports/db uses its stub
  client (writes -> {id:"stub"}, reads -> []). A dev machine with a real Neon
  DATABASE_URL exported made the "stub DB - integration path" jarvis tests hit a
  live (auto-suspended) DB and reject. Guarded on !CI so GitHub Actions keeps the
  ephemeral Postgres it provisions (see ci.yml) and proves exactly what it does
  today. Bonus: `npm test` can never touch a production database locally.

- CRLF-stable hash (resource-intelligence.test.ts): hash the LF-normalised bytes
  of the verified dump. git checks it out CRLF on Windows / LF on Linux, and the
  pinned SHA is the LF hash. Still an exact content pin, now platform-independent.

- Guard subprocess ceiling (guardrails.test.ts): GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS 120s->300s (+
  aligned 330s per-test timeout). spawnSync blocks the worker synchronously so
  vitest's own timeout can't interrupt it; on this machine draft-only/trust-gate
  legitimately take 104-141s even standalone and were killed at 120s. The guard
  still runs to completion and must exit 0.

- Global testTimeout 30s->60s (vitest.config.ts): the first test to import a heavy
  shared package pays a one-time ~12s cold Vite transform; under full-suite CPU
  contention that tipped a trivial import past 30s and flaked. 60s clears the edge
  without masking a real (unbounded) hang.

Validated locally: full apps/web suite 6401/6401 pass (474 files), deterministic
across two full runs. CI behaviour unchanged.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(non-public): 8 backend/internal defects from the launch review

Full-codebase launch review (Phase 2 backend + Phase 3 internal, ~600 files across
20 verified reviewers; public surface handed to Grok). Each finding confirmed against
the code. Validated: prediction-engine 586 + data-ingestion 117 + daily-slate 4 tests
pass; 3-workspace typecheck clean; trust-gate OK.

[HIGH] prediction-engine/probability-calibration.ts — isotonicCalibration (PAVA) did
not compute isotonic regression: it streamed samples as weight-1 singletons with an
xStart-tie hack, yielding a monotone-but-non-optimal map (provably worse SSE on ~79%
of random datasets; off by up to ~13pts). Latent today (CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED
defaults false) but it corrupts the ECE-improvement gate and would ship wrong public
win-probabilities if flipped. Fixed with two-phase PAVA (pre-pool identical forecasts,
then adjacent-violators merge); + regression test that pins the true isotonic optimum.

[HIGH] api/picks/daily-slate/route.ts — in prod totalGames/free/premium were derived
from the demo-only (empty) samples array, so public /picks showed "Games Today: 0"
next to a non-zero total and mislabelled every FREE pick as premium. Now derived from
the real DB when not in demo mode.

[MED] data-ingestion/normalizer.ts — only h2h prices went through sanitizeAmericanPrice;
spread/total prices were stored raw, so a leaked decimal price would fabricate a
spurious edge on a public pick. Now sanitized like h2h (points left untouched).

[MED] api/nflverse/*/route.ts (11 routes) — hardcoded success:true regardless of loader
status masked a source outage as success (breaking the fail-closed truth contract the
sibling /api/intelligence routes honor). Now success = data.status !== "source-error".

[SECURITY / defense-in-depth] app/admin/layout.tsx — /admin had no layout-level auth
gate (unlike /cockpit); protection rested on 37 inline per-page checks. Added a segment
gate so a future admin page can't leak by omitting the check. All 37 current pages
already gate correctly (verified) — this is hardening, not a live hole.

[LOW] admin/statking/scouting/page.tsx — Source Suggestions table mapped non-existent
fields; now reads submitted_url/source_type so the columns populate.

[LOW] lib/bot-outbox/load.ts — 3 DB queries lacked .catch(); /cockpit/bot-outbox now
degrades to its zero-state on a DB outage like its sibling loaders.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(launch-blockers): de-attribute The Beat demo + harden JSON-LD against XSS

Two of the three NO-GO launch blockers from the public-surface audit. The third —
placeholder Terms behind live checkout — is counsel-gated (real v1 terms whose own
docstring says "must be reviewed by counsel before paid checkout"), not a code fix;
flagged for the owner. Validated: 24 targeted tests pass, apps/web typecheck clean,
trust-gate OK.

[BLOCKER · trust/legal] The Beat — DEMO_WIRE (rendered live on /the-beat) attributed
fabricated reports about fictional players to REAL, named NFL journalists (Schefter,
Pelissero, Rapoport, Garafolo), each with a "Confirmed / 90% reliability" badge. The
footer said "fictional," but the cards read as genuine reports from real reporters —
a right-of-publicity / false-light risk on a trust-first product. Fix: fictional demo
sources (no real journalist is ever shown a fabricated report), a "Sample feed ·
fictional sources" marker at the point of display, a clarified disclaimer, and a
regression guard test. NATIONAL_INSIDERS stays an internal reliability seed (names
never rendered).

[BLOCKER · security/XSS] JSON-LD stored XSS — new lib/seo/json-ld.ts + 6 sites
(layout ×2, faq, pricing, journal, journal/[slug], preview). Raw JSON.stringify does
not escape "<", so a value containing "</script>" (a DB journal title, a team name)
breaks out of the <script> tag and executes. jsonLdScript() escapes </>/& to \uXXXX
(parser-transparent) at all six sites. + unit test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(audit): free-tier copy contradiction + casino colors + unguarded calibration claim

Public-surface findings from the launch audit (systemic patterns #3 color / #6 copy;
finding #11). Validated: apps/web typecheck clean, trust-gate OK, no test asserts the
changed copy/colors.

- Free-tier "1 signal/day" contradiction (faq x2, pricing) — FAQ and the pricing FREE
  description said "one signal a day" while the server enforces no cap (dailyPickLimit
  null, picks de-paywalled) and the same pricing page says "Every pick, free / All".
  Aligned all three to the server truth: every pick free; confidence + factor trail
  are the Pro/Elite upgrade.

- Casino colors on /picks + /dashboard (brand doctrine bans green/red/emerald/blue/
  yellow defaults on trust surfaces): /picks settled W/L green-400/red-400 ->
  orbital-cyan/alert, live-dot cyan-300/100 -> orbital-cyan; /dashboard edge + grade-A
  -> verify, grade-B -> orbital-cyan, win-rate highlight -> orbital-cyan, sample yellow
  -> caution.

- Homepage unguarded "calibrated on {settled} settled picks" (page.tsx) — at day-1
  zero data it read "calibrated on 0 settled picks" right above "see the receipts".
  Guarded to "calibration sample building" when settled===0 (matching the sibling
  door-card stat). MethodologySection was already guarded.

fix(a11y): make the shared data kit dark-surface-aware (fixes ink-on-dark on /players & /intelligence/engines)

The consolidated /players (PlayerLabTable) and /intelligence/engines
(EngineView) pages render on the dark cosmic surface (bg-carbon), but the
shared kit — DataTable, KpiCard, SourceError, and the lib/intelligence/colors
tone helpers — only had a light "paper" surface. Two concrete failures:

  • /players: PlayerLabTable already passed dark identifier tokens
    (text-ion-white) while its DataTable rendered a white paper surface —
    white-on-white (~1.07:1). Threading variant="dark" puts the dark tokens on
    a dark surface. Tone/badge cells (buy/sell, injury/agreement) were hardcoded
    to the paper emerald-700/rose-700/amber palette (~2:1 on eclipse); they now
    resolve variant-aware verify/alert/caution tokens.

  • /intelligence/engines: EngineView painted paper ink on the dark page — its
    SubHead <h2> was text-ink (#0E1320) on carbon (#0D1117), ~1.05:1, i.e.
    invisible black-on-black, with white data-cards floating on dark. Converted
    the whole view to the dark surface (ion/mineral/eclipse tokens, dark-bound
    tone helpers, variant="dark" on every DataTable/KpiCard/SourceError).

Mechanism:
  • colors.ts: toneClass/toneRowClass + the buySell/consensus/confidence/
    lift/hitRate/signed wrappers take an optional variant ("paper" default, so
    all ~14 existing paper board callers are untouched); dark → verify/alert +
    bg-verify/10 / bg-alert/10 row tints instead of the glaring bg-emerald-50.
  • data-table.tsx: variant prop already added; row-tint now passes variant.
  • kpi-card.tsx: toned value follows the surface (was paper tone on dark card).
  • player-lab-table.tsx: TABLE_TOKENS gains variant-aware good/bad/warn + status
    badge tokens; all tone sites route through them.
  • engine-view.tsx: full paper→dark token conversion; dark-bound tc/sc/hc/lc
    aliases; variant="dark" on DataTable/KpiCard/SourceError.

Additive and reversible. Validated: typecheck clean, trust-gate clean (1058
files), colors + data-table unit suites 31 passed. No live gates touched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(compliance): collapse soft line-wraps before no-claim scanning (evasion close)

A multi-word banned phrase split across an editor soft-wrap ("a sure\nthing")
rendered as one continuous claim but slipped the submit-time compliance scanner,
whose rule regexes match a literal space, not "\n". normalizeForComplianceScan()
folds CRLF->LF and collapses single soft newlines to spaces (preserving \n\n
paragraph breaks so real sentence boundaries never merge into a false phrase),
applied before scanning in all four gates: bot-outbox, waitlist no-claim guard,
model-journal, and studio build-assets. Mirrors the read-time public-journal
guard so submit-time and read-time enforcement stay in lock-step.

Regression suite (11 tests): evasion caught across all three public scanners AND
paragraph-break / innocent-wrap false positives NOT flagged.

Validated: typecheck clean, 11/11 pass. (Reviewed follow-up-task work before commit.)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(ingestion): stop the daily cron starving the board + surface the real failure reason

Diagnosed from live Vercel prod logs (project sports-web):
  - 64× "[cron:refresh-odds] baseball_mlb failed: Upstream odds are stale: no
    game has a fresh bookmaker update" → 0 picks generated, every day.

Root cause: the per-game odds-freshness gate (FRESHNESS_THRESHOLD_MS) demanded
bookmaker updates <1h old, but the DEPLOYED Vercel refresh-odds cron runs once
daily at 10:00 UTC (6am ET) — ~13h before MLB first pitch — so every line is >1h
old at fetch time and every game is dropped. The 1h value also contradicted the
platform's own shared Refresh SLA, which already declares 4h the staleness line
for the daily cron (refresh-sla.ts REFRESH_STALE_AFTER_MINUTES).

Fix:
  - Align the odds gate to the 4h SLA and expose ODDS_FRESHNESS_MAX_HOURS so the
    freshness-vs-availability trade is an explicit owner knob (config.ts).
  - Update normalizer.test.ts stale fixtures to 5h so they still assert genuine
    staleness rejection at the new 4h boundary (intent preserved, not gamed).
  - Cockpit ingestion alarm now surfaces the most-recent FAILED run's
    errorMessage (jarvis / jarvis-data) so "58 failures" reads WHY — quota vs
    stale vs DB-unreachable — instead of a generic "investigate the data adapter."

Also documents the two blockers only the owner can clear (Neon DB reachability +
the picks-table GRANT + Odds API credits + the gate/Stripe flips) in
handoff/claude/overnight-2026-07-01/GO-LIVE-real-state-and-levers.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(ci): green PR #61 — em-dash copy guard + shape-complete daily-slate db mock

Two of the three CI failures on the merge with post-#60/#62 main:

1. em-dash-scan: 5 em/en-dashes in wire.ts + the-beat.tsx comments (from the
   journalist de-attribution fix) tripped the brand-voice guard. Replaced with
   plain punctuation; scanner exits OK (9 copy files clean).

2. "db.pick.findMany is not a function": a semantic merge conflict. main's
   daily-slate-stale-kill-switch.test.ts mocks @sports/db with pick={count}
   only, while this branch's daily-slate fix derives totalGames via
   db.pick.findMany({distinct:["gameId"]}). The TypeError is synchronous, so
   the route's own .catch() can never engage. Mock is now shape-complete
   (findMany -> []); test intent (kill-switch behavior) unchanged.

Also merges origin/main (post #60/#62) into the branch. Palette/token guards
verified green locally (brand-palette-guard 7, palette-cohesion 2,
picks-design-token-integrity 3).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test: confidenceLabel asserts the design tokens, not the retired casino palette

The confidenceLabel color field was modernized to GSE tokens
(verify/orbital-cyan/caution/ion-2) in the trust-surface color batch; the test

failure on PR #61. Full local suite tally after all three fixes: the 6 failing
tests (3 daily-slate mock + 3 here) all pass; 6427 total.

+/**
+ * Compliance Scanner — input normalization.
+ *
+ * Submit-time enforcement scans author-supplied Markdown against the banned
+ * vocabulary in `rules.ts`. Editors (and Markdown authoring in general) soft-wrap
+ * long lines, so a multi-word banned phrase can end up split across a newline:
+ *
+ *     ...the model favors the home side. basically a sure
+ *     thing for Sunday.
+ *
+ * Markdown renders that soft wrap as one continuous sentence ("...a sure thing
+ * for Sunday."), but the rule regexes match a literal space, not a "\n" — so the
+ * wrapped phrase would slip the gate. This collapses soft wraps back into single
+ * spaces BEFORE scanning so authoring-time enforcement can't be evaded by an
+ * editor line-break.
+ *
+ * This is the same normalization the read-time public-journal guard applies,
+ * keeping the submit-time gate and the read-time backstop in lock-step.
+ *
+ * Behavior:
+ *   - CRLF is folded to LF first.
+ *   - A single "soft" newline (one not adjacent to another newline) becomes a
+ *     space, in place. This is length-preserving for LF content, so any match
+ *     offsets/spans computed against the result stay aligned with the source.
+ *   - Paragraph breaks (blank lines / "\n\n") are preserved, so words on either
+ *     side of a real paragraph boundary are NOT merged into a false phrase.
+ *
+ * Pure: no I/O, no side effects.
+ */
+export function normalizeForComplianceScan(text: string): string {
+  return text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").replace(/([^\n])\n(?!\n)/g, "$1 ");
+}

+ * Safe serializer for JSON-LD embedded in a `<script type="application/ld+json">`.
+ *
+ * `JSON.stringify` does NOT escape `<`, `>`, or `&`, so any value that ever
+ * contains the sequence `</script>` — a journal title or body sourced from the
+ * DB, a team name from an odds feed, an FAQ answer — breaks out of the script
+ * element and the trailing markup is parsed as HTML: a stored/reflected XSS.
+ *
+ * Escaping those three characters to their `\uXXXX` forms keeps the payload
+ * inside the script tag while remaining byte-identical to JSON parsers (Google's
+ * Rich Results reader included). This is the standard, framework-agnostic
+ * hardening for inline JSON-LD and must be used at EVERY
+ * `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` JSON-LD site instead of raw `JSON.stringify`.
+ */
+export function jsonLdScript(data: unknown): string {
+  return JSON.stringify(data)
+    .replace(/</g, "\\u003c")
+    .replace(/>/g, "\\u003e")
+    .replace(/&/g, "\\u0026");
+}
